summary: Members of Council may file petitions.
decided: City Council on October 29 and 30, 2019, received the following petition for information: 1. Petition requesting the City to study the possibility of installing speed humps at/on 83 Mondeo Drive, directly in front of the security gatehouse between Birchmount Road and Kennedy Road on Ellesmere Road in Scarborough, submitted by Councillor Michael Thompson, Ward 21, Scarborough Centre, containing the signatures of approximately 130 persons.
text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on October 29 and 30, 2019, received the following petition for information: 1. Petition requesting the City to study the possibility of installing speed humps at/on 83 Mondeo Drive, directly in front of the security gatehouse between Birchmount Road and Kennedy Road on Ellesmere Road in Scarborough, submitted by Councillor Michael Thompson, Ward 21, Scarborough Centre, containing the signatures of approximately 130 persons.
